evals.prompt: Research the current OpenClaw multi-agent routing model for an upcoming article.
expectations: Runs at least two differently phrased searches.
Cites only fetched URLs with a retrieval date.
Classifies each finding with an evidence tier.
Names a suggested next skill or persona.

evals.prompt: Two fetched sources give different release dates for the same software version.
expectations: Lists both claims under conflicts with sources.

evals.prompt: Run research when web_search and web_fetch are unavailable.
expectations: Returns a packet limited to supplied material with gaps listed.
